title: SDD Pricing (sdd/pricing.json)
description: Tarifas editables que el visor SDD usa para la comparativa de costos: estimación tradicional (horas × tarifa) versus costo agéntico aproximado (tokens × precio por tier). No afecta al ciclo SDD — es solo entrada del dashboard.

traditional_hourly_rate.description: Costo por hora de desarrollo tradicional usado contra estimation_hours de las tasks.

model_prices_per_mtok.description: Keys are provider-namespaced models (claude/opus, gemini/pro, copilot/gpt-5-mini). Bare legacy keys (haiku|sonnet|opus|fable) are still accepted and read as claude/*. Prices are USD per 1M tokens; Copilot entries use the public per-model token rates behind GitHub AI Credits.
